Kissing number in dimension 5, lower bound · Sphere packing and kissing · status current

Definition

tau_5 = the maximum number of non-overlapping unit spheres in R^5 touching a central unit sphere. Entries record the best lower bound.

\tau_5

Domain: point sets on S^4. Normalisation: count. Direction: max.
